case: domain-over-enum array result through file writers and SQL replay
contract: A domain-over-enum array remains a lossless text fallback that can be rebound to the qualified domain-array type with matching array_to_json and array_send oracles.
JSON, CSV, XML, HTML, Markdown and XLSX preserve the array text, and SQL export replays into a domain-array column with matching native type, canonical text, JSON and wire bytes.

focused_test.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration domain_array_file_export_contract::value_contract_domain_enum_array_file_exports_preserve_values_and_native_type -- --include-ignored --exact --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings

repository_guards.result: file-size and function-size guards report existing unrelated violations; the new test file is below the file-size limit
